rules.placement: Each round the builder (Miner) places 5 random gems ("Random Gem", costs 1 lumber each; you get 5 lumber per round). After the 5th gem you choose ONE to keep (Keep). All other placed gems of that round turn into Mazing Rocks (walls). Gems are 2x2 structures that block pathing; creeps must path through your maze from spawn via checkpoints to your mine.
rules.combining_same_gems: Among the 5 gems of the current round: 2 identical gems (same type & quality) -> Combine x2 = +1 quality; Gem TD+ also 3 (x3) or 4 (x4) identical = +2 qualities (BK v3.1: "4 Perfect of the same" combine). Going beyond Great creates the Stone of Bryvx. The combined gem is the one kept.
rules.downgrade: After placing, a non-Chipped gem may be downgraded one quality (Downgrade button, BK since v2.2).
rules.special_combination: Special recipe: all ingredient gems must be owned at the same time, either all within this round's 5 placed gems ("one-hit": one of them can be turned into the special directly) OR spread over kept gems from previous rounds anywhere on your field plus this round. A "Combine Special" button appears on the ingredient; the special is created at that ingredient's position, the other ingredients turn into rocks (slates are just removed). Kills of all ingredients are summed into the special.
rules.special_upgrades: Specials are upgraded like WC3 buildings for gold (no extra gems needed). Upgrade cost = gold cost of the target tower (see recipe.gold_cost_*). Upgrade refunds 100% if cancelled (Gem TD+).
rules.rocks: Unchosen gems become Mazing Rocks (10 HP structures, gold value 3). Each rock has a free "Remove Rock" ability (no gold cost, no mana) usable at any time; no wave/round restriction found in script. Combining specials leaves rocks where the ingredients stood.
rules.slates: Basic slates only from the round placement (Normal + Flawed recipe) or Extra Chance (Slate). Slates do not block creeps (creeps walk over them). BK: each slate can teleport once anywhere within 2000 range. Gem TD+: base slates may stack on other base slates of a different type.

gem_quality_upgrade.name: Increase Gem Quality (research on the Mine), 8 levels
gem_quality_upgrade.type_distribution: All 8 gem types equally likely (12.5% each); quality rolled by the table above. Great gems cannot be rolled, only combined.

extra_chance.bk31: Extra Chance (175 gold): choose a Perfect gem type; next round each of the 5 placed gems has a higher chance to become it. Extra Chance Slate (125 gold): same for a chosen slate. Once per round. Normal chance ~1.25%/gem; with Extra Chance 5.95%/gem (v2.2); "Increase Extra Chances" research (5 levels, from 50 gold) raises it 3/83 ... 8/88 per gem placed. Requires max Gem Quality? (not verified for BK).
extra_chance.gemtd_plus: Gem TD+: Extra Chance (175 gold for a Perfect type, 125 for a slate) only available after Gem Quality level 8; active for the whole placement round; bonus multiplier grows (up to 10x) when used repeatedly in the same class; weights: total 80, slate initial 18.75, type initial 25.

waves.bk31_classic: 42 levels in Classic mode; damage tests (bosses) at levels 14, 28 (150,000 HP) and 42 (final, 700,000 HP). Race mode: 50 levels, level 25 "ReRunner" boss, final damage test 1.5 M HP.
waves.gemtd_plus: 50 levels; 10 creeps per level spawned every 1.61 s; level 50: 10 minions (85,000 HP) + boss "Damage Test" 500,000 HP.
waves.air_levels: Every 4th level is air: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 36, 40, 44, 48 (Gem TD+ list; BK classic same up to 40).

lives.bk31: Mine has 50 max HP = lives; game starts with 15 lives (30%). A leaking creep removes as many lives as its gold bounty. Buy Life at the mine: 10 gold per life, max 50.
lives.gemtd_plus: Max lives reduced to 30 in 1.5.4; lives removed entirely in 1.6.0 (leaks only cost time/gold).

economy.start: BK v3.1: 10 gold, 5 lumber at start.
economy.bounty: Each creep gives gold = level-dependent bounty (Gem TD+ list: level 1-3: 1 gold, rising to 20 gold at levels 48-50).
economy.swap: BK: Black Opal / Mystic Black Opal / Rose Quartz have Swap (200 gold) to exchange positions with another gem or rock. Gem TD+ 1.6: Swap is a builder ability costing 10 mana (builder 10 max mana, +1 per level).

rules.kill_ranks: Every tower gains +10% damage per 10 kills (Valued 10, Prized 20, Meaningful 30, Adored 40, Recognized 50, Cherished 60, Honored 70 ... Worshipped 120+: +120%). Immolation/spell levels of Star Ruby line, Uranium, Viper/Elder/Poison slates grow 1 level per 10 kills (Gem TD+: +10% per 10 kills, cap 100 kills).

armor_damage_table.note: WC3 Gameplay constants (identical in BK v3.1 and Gem TD+). Columns: small, medium, large, fortified, normal, hero, divine, unarmored.

rules.misc: Frost slow 20% (global constant). Minimum unit speed 220, max 522. Sapphire/Silver/Yellow Sapphire slows do not stack (same buff).

abilities: 30 dmg 0.5 s hits all targets within 750; burn 50 dmg/s within 400; +10% damage aura within 400 (+5% per 10 kills up to 60%; not stacking with Damage Slate).
abilities_gemtd_plus: Multishot all in 750, 30 dmg 0.5 s; Burn 50 dps 400 (+10%/10 kills); Enhance +10% dmg 400 (+3% per kill level, max 40%).
slates.path_note: Creeps walk over slates (no pathing footprint, collision 32). Slates can be placed on the maze path; they do not act as walls.

uncertain: Primary damage/cooldown/range values are from [BK's] Gem TD v3.1 object data (exact); "gemtd_plus_1_6_14" sub-objects hold the Gem TD+ values (exact). Earlier Bryvx versions (v1.x-v2.x, the very first "Gem TD" by Bryvx) may differ and were not checked.

Damage ranges computed as base+dice .. base+dice*sides using WC3 defaults of the base unit (Guard Tower/Cannon Tower/Ancient Protector) where a field was not overridden; this matches the Gem TD+ in-game tooltips.

Sapphire/Silver/Yellow Sapphire slow duration 5 s and amount 20% come from the WC3 Frost Attack default + map constant FrostMoveSpeedDecrease=0.2 (Gem TD+ tooltip confirms 20%/5 s; for BK assumed identical since constant is the same).
BK v3.1 Emerald Normal duration (5 s) and Perfect/Great slow (50%) partly from WC3 Slow Poison defaults/tooltips, not explicit fields.
BK Uranium 238 slow: object data says -75% but in-game tooltip says 50%; actual in-game value capped by minimum speed 220.
BK Ancient Slate damage formula "(kills x 5-120) + (level x 50)" is quoted from the in-game tooltip; exact trigger formula not verified.
Ruby splash: WC3 splash uses full/medium/small radii with damage factors (default 100%/50%/25%); factors not extracted.
Rock removal: no cost found in either version (ability without gold/mana cost). Some other Gem TD variants (e.g. Dota 2 Gem TD) charge gold for rock removal - not WC3.
Extra Chance for BK: whether it needs max Gem Quality is not verified (Gem TD+ requires level 8).
German names (name_de) are my own translations, not official.
Dota 2 Gem TD uses different names (Asian Jade, Lucky Asian Jade, Uranium 238->235 etc.) and different numbers; not used except for name mapping.
Gem TD+ 1.6.x removed lives and some BK features (race mode, gamble machines, classic mode); rule text above notes this.

Stone of Bryvx in BK v3.1: confirmed via 4 identical Perfects; whether 2 Greats also work in BK is not verified (it does in TD+). The gemtd-helper data for TD+ 1.5.4 lists 'one Perfect of each of the 8 gem types' as its recipe, which conflicts with the TD+ 1.6 code.
Creep HP list (rules.creeps_gemtd_plus) is TD+ base object data. TD+ scales HP by difficulty and changelog adjustments (+20% air and levels 41-49), and BK classic values differ.
